description: List SmartUI builds in a project, get one build, or get the CI gate verdict for a build. Use action=gate in pipelines: it returns verdict (passed|failed|pending_approval|running|error), totals (including missing screenshots the baseline has), blocking_comparison_ids, and blocking[] with per-item detail. verdict=failed covers rejections AND builds that dropped baseline screenshots. Read-only.

action.description: list builds, get one build, or gate (CI verdict)

build_id.description: Build id — required for get/gate (or use build_name)

build_name.description: Build name — alternative to build_id for get/gate

build_status.description: Substring filter on build status (list only), e.g. "pending-approval"

name: smartui_build_query
title: SmartUI Build Query
